en.headline: SFC suspends Cloudbreak Pharma shares over suspected IPO rigging
en.dek: The regulator directed the exchange to halt trading from 9am on Thursday, saying it has serious concerns the 2025 listing may have created an artificial impression of demand.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission has directed the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong to suspend trading in Cloudbreak Pharma, saying it has serious concerns that the company's initial public offering last year may have been rigged.

In a statement on Thursday, the SFC said the offering may have been arranged to create an artificial impression of demand for the shares. It considered the halt necessary or expedient to maintain an orderly and fair market and to protect the investing public while its investigation continues. The suspension took effect at 9am on 10 September under section 8(1) of the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules.

Cloudbreak, a biotechnology firm focused on treatments for eye disease, listed on the Main Board on 3 July 2025 at HK$10.10 a share and raised about HK$612 million. The shares fell 39 per cent on the first day of trading and closed at HK$1.19 on Wednesday, more than 90 per cent below the issue price. The SFC said it would make no further comment while the investigation is underway.

zh.headline: 證監會勒令撥康視雲停牌 指IPO或涉人為操縱需求
zh.dek: 證監會周四上午9時起指示聯交所暫停02592股份買賣，指對去年上市或被操縱以營造需求假象表示嚴重關注。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會周四指示香港聯合交易所暫停撥康視雲製藥股份買賣，指對該公司去年首次公開招股或曾被人為操縱表示嚴重關注。
證監會發表聲明，指有關招股或被安排以營造對股份需求的假象。在調查進行期間，暫停交易對維持有秩序及公平的市場，以及保障投資大眾利益屬有需要或合宜。停牌由9月10日上午9時起生效，依據為《證券及期貨（在證券市場上市）規則》第8(1)條。
撥康視雲為專注眼科治療的生物科技公司，2025年7月3日以每股10.10元在主板上市，集資約6.12億元。股份上市首日下跌39%，周三收市報1.19元，較招股價下跌逾九成。證監會表示，調查進行期間不會再作評論。
